beforeShellExecution.prompt: The agent is about to create a GitHub pull request. Allow only if README.md and any relevant files under docs/ or plans/ already match the current system for the changes on this branch (or the PR is documentation-only). Deny if those docs are missing or stale. If you deny, tell the agent to update README.md and docs accordingly, commit the doc files, then retry `gh pr create`. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
